title: Evidence sparsification & tiered crediting matrix for SIG/CAIQ bundles
creator: Claire Zhang
description: Problem: Enterprise customers request full SIG/CAIQ bundles during negotiations; producing full evidence is time-consuming for SEs and costly for internal teams. Current attestation packs are often over-complete for low-risk customers and under-indexed for high-risk ones. Goal: design and pilot an automated 'evidence sparsification' step plus a tiered crediting matrix that reduces customer effort and aligns pricing credits to evidence density and risk tier. This ticket scopes a PM-led experiment to prototype the sparsification heuristics, UX for self-serve compressed bundles, and pricing rules that convert evidence size and criticality into refundable security credit. Success criteria will be both operational (reduction in average pages delivered, SE time saved) and commercial (no negative impact on close rates, measurable uplift in sales throughput).
acceptance_criteria: 1) PoC sparsifier reduces median evidence payload by >=45% on a representative set of 200 historical questionnaire responses without removing required control statements. 2) Tiered credit matrix defined (Light/Standard/Full) with mapping to usage credits and product SKUs. 3) UI flows and download package implemented in a staging console link for user testing. 4) Metric dashboard created: avg evidence size, SE time to prepare, deployment defects, close-rate delta for pilot cohort. 5) Legal and security sign-off recorded in decision_log.
